about: Trees, rocks and plants used up: felled, crumbled, picked, for every node without its own.
notes: v1 brief for the torch backend (MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 on CUDA). Each prompt asks for several events with pauses in one 8 s file, and the picker cuts the best of them. Slots with loop: true are beds: the picker cuts a seamless stretch.

prompts.text: A tall tree is felled: wood cracking and splintering, then a long crashing fall through branches and a heavy thud, one fall. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large rock cracks and crumbles apart into rubble, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Leaves and berries are stripped from a bush by hand: rustling twigs and snapping stems, five separate pulls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
